recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Only revisit if FHIR-I decides to add publisher support for logical-pattern spreadsheet artifacts or a new Detailed Analysis legend; otherwise continue using resource-specific mapping-exception files and trackers for rationale cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-20695 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested Event, Request, Definition, and FiveWs variance tables that are easier to review: spreadsheet links if worthwhile, a legend, and a formal way to document suppressed workflow-warning overrides and flag unexplained variances.
initial_application: No commit explicitly names FHIR-20695. The relevant application appears in related history: 2019 pattern support and pattern analysis commits, the FHIR-20621 shared logical-pattern legend commit, and March 2023 mapping-exception schema/file commits that allow unmapped and divergent pattern elements to carry reasons.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps definition, event, request, and fivews active as logical models. tools/templates/template-logical.html contains the shared Mappings legend, tools/templates/template-logical-analysis.html renders Detailed Cross Analysis, and tools/schema/mappingExceptions.xsd plus current *-mapping-exceptions.xml files provide the maintained rationale mechanism. Current build probes show the analysis pages render tables and the optional .xlsx links are not published; the Jira resolution explicitly did not require spreadsheet links.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. A source edit would either duplicate existing common-template/mapping-exception support or add unsafe links to artifacts not currently generated.
